verdict.rationale: Chargebee's docs say users can 'use AI inside the Chargebee Billing UI to answer questions and complete tasks' (docs-16). They also say Chargebee AI can draft product families, plans, addons, prices, features and entitlements from a pricing page or description (docs-14), which is in-product task delegation. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what tasks the assistant can perform and its limits or approval flow, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
